Phase 12 fresh factual 실행은 98,304 environment transitions를 완료했고, 공개 고정된 636개 blinded onset schedule이 모든 6개 cell의 최소 support를 통과했다.
Phase 12 최종 gate는 primary 0.000171, LP-over-RAW -0.005098, fixed-observation entropy harm veto로 REJECT됐다.
Phase 13 disjoint-probe model-gain preregistration은 exact HTTPS에 고정됐고 4,096-case analytic unit gate가 environment/outcome 0회로 통과했다.
Phase 13 구현 freeze, 384개 진단 상태, 6-cell training plan은 source commit 3953b9e에 결속됐고 evaluation-world bytes와 outcomes는 0이다.

curated_report_sections.Best result: The v3 material need-share rate advantage replicated in seeds 404, 505, and 606. Across 64 fixed held-out worlds per seed, median POSITIVE-SHARE minus CTRL-NONE gain was `+0.9971` deterministic and `+0.7798` sampled. Median beneficial energy units per eligible need timestep gained `+2.0445` and `+2.1946`, respectively. Maximum energy-accounting error across v3 learned runs remained below `1.81e-05`.
curated_report_sections.Executive summary: Day 1 has produced eight immutable exploratory experiment blocks, one fresh CEF-10 checkpoint-training block, and a tested, restartable two-agent stack. A direct-reward v3 control learned material energy transfer on 64 held-out worlds in each of three training seeds, but this remains engineered behavior rather than emergence: the policies manufactured 5--8 times more need opportunities, cycled energy bidirectionally, and shortened sampled episodes in every seed. No JEPA condition has run and every emergence score remains unscored. The last source-bound suite before phase-3/4 integration passed `326/326`; a new full receipt is pending. Partial resume is provenance-locked, interrupts and unsupported jobs fail closed, and semantic progress publication is nonblocking and retryable. The old schedule record remains nonexecuting and cannot open `FALSIFY-v1.1`; execution authority instead flows through the separately validated CEF parent DAG and typed adapter. CEF-01..09 are complete (`9/9`) at replacement CEF-09 freeze `49424c7b31a01f04e0ecf89dbee5d9849bd4845305d629556bb6d4ecd910170b`. The accepted firewall reconstructs internal parent edges and exact content contracts, then derives three typed views only after one committed opaque read. CEF-10 has executed factual enumeration and screen-domain-only neutral screening, then selected 485 windows without reading estimation outcomes. The schedule remains unanchored; estimation, do-minus-i, final gate evaluation, and JEPA remain locked. This is evaluator engineering progress, not causal or emergence evidence. The JEPA matrix remains pending and unclaimed.
curated_report_sections.Human-readable conclusion: We can reliably train agents to transfer energy when directly rewarded, but we still cannot say that the transfers preserve a partner: sampled episodes end sooner and much of the flow cancels in the opposite direction. The research system now prevents several ways this ambiguity could be hidden—mixed-source resume, unsupported-job claiming, fuzzy public evidence, invented zeroes, and a manifest that overstates readiness. There is still no JEPA or social-emergence result. The scientifically useful next move is the fresh CEF-10 calibration under the now-frozen evaluator.
curated_report_sections.Strongest alternative explanation: The rewarded controller learns to approach, remain close, and cycle energy to harvest gross-transfer reward. The material-rate signal is real but need not be partner preservation. For future JEPA cells, the strongest alternative remains predictability management by immobilization, simplification, synchronization, or death.
curated_report_sections.Suspicious results: The deterministic mean action can delay first death in one seed while the sampled policy shortens life in every seed. Because every episode ends at the first death, mean alive fraction hides this difference. Fixed-horizon counterfactual survival, net receiver gain, opportunity creation, collision/contact, and role-conditioned mortality must be reported together.

limitations: v3은 행동을 직접 지정하는 공유 보상을 쓴 양성대조군이다.
고정 world 평가는 조건 간 독립 실행의 관찰 비교이며 개입적 인과 추정량이 없다.
공유 정책은 대조군보다 훨씬 많은 need opportunity를 만들고 거리를 바꿨다.
v3 실행 메타데이터의 git revision은 당시 dirty/untracked 실행 코드를 온전히 식별하지 못한다.
Phase 11은 단일 학습 seed의 exploratory Stage 1이므로 유리한 하위 진단도 일반화할 수 없다.
anti-collapse의 표현 rank 개선은 사회적 행동이나 상대 보존의 증거가 아니다.
Phase 12 LP 단위 gate의 stationary-noise signed mean은 0.000167이지만 절대 보상 평균은 0.07726으로 높아 noise-seeking 위험을 실제 학습에서 추적해야 한다.
Phase 12는 단일 학습 seed의 exploratory REJECT이며 유리한 mortality interaction 하나를 일반화할 수 없다.
Phase 12 representation PASS는 비붕괴 표현의 증거일 뿐 상대 보존·사회 행동·안전성의 증거가 아니다.
Phase 13 unit PASS는 affine-head 수학과 noise-bank 경계만 검증하며 training 효과나 noisy-TV 면역을 검증하지 않는다.
heartbeat는 SIGKILL 이후 liveness를 단독으로 증명하지 못한다.

analysis.claim_boundary: Phase 9 PASS는 positive-control calibration의 evaluator capability만 입증한다. Phase 10은 exploratory single-seed REJECT이며 mortality-on에서 effect 기준 미달과 세 harm veto가 발생했다. Rank diagnostic은 Level-1 설계 동기일 뿐 JEPA 효과, 협력, 이타성 또는 emergence 증거가 아니고 Stage 2도 잠겨 있다.
analysis.next_decision: 새로운 outcome-free JEPA-L1 anti-collapse protocol에서 variance/covariance coefficient, representation gate, harm gate, fresh seeds와 fresh worlds를 고정하고 exact public HTTPS anchor를 확인한다. 그 전에는 training을 실행하지 않는다.
analysis.status_interpretation: CEF-01..10은 10/10 완료이고 evaluator capability calibration도 종결됐다. Phase 9 FALSIFY-v1.4 positive-control capability는 3/3 시드 PASS였다. Phase 10 FALSIFY-v1.5 Stage 1은 7,864,320 training transitions, 212,992 capability branches와 4,194,304 harm transitions 뒤 REJECT됐다. 후속 frozen diagnostic은 prediction-pressure 두 cell의 latent effective rank가 각각 3.6297과 3.9483으로 4 미만임을 측정했다.
